items.title: 10.7 Lenz ka qanoon aur induced emf ki simt (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.7 in the book's order (PDF 240-243), with Examples 10.6 and 10.7 and self-checks.

blocks.text: Pichhle topic mein Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke qanoon ki riyazi (mathematical) shakal yeh nikli thi:

Is mein minus ki alamat bohat aham hai; yeh induced emf ki simt batati hai. Simt maloom karne ke liye hum woh usool istemal karte hain jo Russian physicist Heinrich Lenz ne 1834 mein daryaft kiya. Us ne dekha ke induced emf ki polarity (kaun sa sira + aur kaun sa −) hamesha aisa induced current paida karti hai jo magnetic field ki us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat (oppose) kare jis ne emf paida ki. Ise Lenz ka qanoon kehte hain:

blocks.title: Lenz ka qanoon
blocks.text: Induced current ki simt hamesha aisi hoti hai ke woh us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne current paida kiya.

Lenz ka qanoon seedha induced current par lagta hai, induced emf par nahi. Is liye ise band (closed) loops ya coils par lagate hain. Agar loop khula ho to farz kar lein ke band hai, induced current ki simt nikalein, aur us se induced emf ki simt samajh lein.

Ab Lenz ka qanoon us coil par lagayein jis mein bar magnet ki harkat se current induce hota hai. Current wali coil bar magnet jaisi field banati hai: coil ka ek rukh (face) north pole aur doosra south pole ban jata hai. Magnet ki harkat ki mukhalifat ke liye coil ka magnet ki taraf wala rukh north pole banna chahiye (Fig. 10.15), taa ke do north poles ek doosre ko dhakelein (repel). Right-hand rule ke mutabiq magnet ki taraf se dekhne par coil mein current anticlockwise behna chahiye.

blocks.alt: Baen: bar magnet, S phir N, velocity v se coil ki taraf chal raha hai; magenta field lines us ke N sire se phailti hain. Daen: coil apni field lines ke saath; axis wali lakeer daen B se baen N tak jati hai, yaani magnet ki taraf wala rukh N hai. Coil ke sire galvanometer wale circuit se jure hain jis par current ke teer aur current is anticlockwise likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.15: Coil ki taraf dhakela bar magnet: coil ka magnet ki taraf wala rukh north pole ban jata hai (kitab ki Figure 10.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnet ka N coil ki taraf aa raha hai, is liye coil apne qareebi rukh par N banati hai taa ke dhakel kar is harkat ki mukhalifat kare: coil ki axis par field lines baen ki taraf (magnet ki taraf) nikalti hain. Magnet ki taraf se dekhein to aisi field ke liye current anticlockwise hona chahiye, jo galvanometer wale circuit ke teer dikhate hain.

Lenz ke qanoon ke mutabiq magnet ka “dhakka” (push) hi woh “tabdeeli” hai jo current paida karti hai, aur current is dhakke ki mukhalifat karta hai. Agar magnet ko coil se door khainchein to induced current is “khinchav” (pull) ki mukhalifat karta hai: coil ka magnet ki taraf wala rukh south pole ban jata hai jo magnet ko wapas khainchta hai.

Lenz ka qanoon energy ki baqa (conservation of energy, energy na banti hai na khatam hoti hai) ke qanoon ki ek shakal bhi hai. Fig. 10.16 ka tajurba dobara dekhein. Rod daen chalti hai to us mein emf induce hoti hai aur loop mein anticlockwise current behta hai. Current wali rod magnetic field mein chal rahi hai, is liye us par magnetic force F_m lagti hai jis ki miqdar F_m = ILB sin90° hai.

Right-hand rule se F_m ki simt velocity v ke ulat hai, is liye yeh rod ko rokne ki koshish karti hai (Fig. 10.16-a). Rod ko mustaqil velocity se chalate rehne ke liye F_m ke barabar magar ulti simt mein bahar se force lagani parti hai. Yahi bahar ki force woh energy deti hai jis se induced current behta hai. Yun electromagnetic induction energy ki baqa ke qanoon ki pabandi karta hai.

blocks.alt: Galvanometer se band patriyon par rod ke do hisse, B kaghaz ke andar. (a) Current I rod mein oopar, oopar wali patri par baen aur neeche wali par daen (anticlockwise); magnetic force F_m baen, velocity v ke ulat, aur haath rod ko kheench raha hai. (b) Current I rod mein neeche aur patriyon ke teer ulte (clockwise); F_m daen, v ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.16: (a) Induced current anticlockwise: F_m, v ki mukhalif; (b) clockwise soorat jo Lenz ka qanoon mana karta hai (kitab ki Figure 10.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein current rod mein oopar hai; F = I L x B se force baen aati hai, yaani harkat ki mukhalif, is liye rod ko chalate rehne ke liye haath ko kaam karna parta hai: yahi energy current mein jati hai. (b) mein current ulta ho to force v ki taraf hoti aur rod khud ba khud tez hoti jati, yaani muft energy. Yeh energy ki baqa ke khilaf hai, is liye Lenz ka qanoon (b) ko mana karta hai.

Lenz ka qanoon yahan clockwise current ki ijazat nahi deta, kyunke tab F_m, v ki simt mein hoti aur rod ko daen taraf tez (accelerate) karti (Fig. 10.16-b). Is se current aur barhta, us ki field aur magnetic force bhi barhti, aur rod aur tez hoti jati. Yani bohat thori energy se shuru ho kar baghair kisi source ke barhti hui kinetic energy mil jati, aur yeh silsila khud ba khud chalta rehta. Yeh energy ki baqa ke qanoon ke khilaf hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.6
blocks.problem: 25 cm lambi dhaati rod 0.25 T magnetic field ke perpendicular 0.5 m s⁻¹ ki speed se chal rahi hai. Rod mein paida hone wali emf nikalein.
steps: Formula: ε = vBL (miqdar, minus alamat sirf simt batati hai)

blocks.title: Point to ponder
blocks.text: Resistance ko nazar-andaz karein to kya coil mein mustaqil (constant) current coil ke siron par potential difference bana sakta hai?

blocks.title: Example 10.7
blocks.problem: Taar ka ek loop uniform magnetic field mein rakha hai jo loop ki satah ke perpendicular hai. Field 0.6 T hai. Loop ka raqba mustaqil sharah ΔA/Δt = 0.8 m² s⁻¹ se sukarne lagta hai. Sukarte waqt loop mein induced emf ki miqdar kya hai?
steps: Field satah ke perpendicular hai, yani B aur normal ka zawiya 0°: flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah Δϕ/Δt = B (ΔA/Δt) cos0° = B (ΔA/Δt)
Faraday ka qanoon (miqdar): ε = N ΔΦ/Δt = NB ΔA/Δt
blocks.answer: Loop mein induced emf 0.48 V hai.

blocks.prompt: Bar magnet ek jame hue (fixed) dhaati chhalle se guzar kar girta hai. Kya woh free fall ke acceleration g se girega (short question 10.5)? Circuit ka switch band karne par coil ke oopar rakha dhaati chhalla uchhalta hai; kyun, aur battery ki polarity ulat dene par kya hoga (constructed response 10.2)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Magnet ke qareeb aane aur door jane par badalta flux chhalle mein aise currents induce karta hai jo Lenz ke qanoon se harkat ki mukhalifat karte hain: chhalla aate magnet ko dhakelta aur jate ko khainchta hai, is liye magnet g se kam acceleration se girta hai. Switch band karne par chhalle se flux achanak barhta hai; induced current chhalle ko aisa magnet bana deta hai jo is izafe ki mukhalifat kare, is liye chhalla dhakela jata aur uchhalta hai. Battery ulatne se coil ki field aur induced current dono ulat jate hain, is liye chhalla phir bhi dhakela jata aur uchhalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Resistance nazar-andaz karte hue, kya coil mein mustaqil current us par potential difference bana sakta hai (Point to ponder)? Patriyon par sarakti rod se jure bulb ki electrical energy kahan se aati hai (constructed response 10.8)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Mustaqil current mustaqil flux banata hai, is liye coil mein koi emf induce nahi hoti, aur resistance na hone se IR wala girao (drop) bhi nahi; koi potential difference nahi. Bulb ki energy rod ko khainchne wale se aati hai: induced current ki wajah se field rod ko peeche dhakelti hai, aur is rokne wali force ke khilaf kiya gaya kaam bulb mein electrical energy ban jata hai.

items: Lenz (1834): induced current hamesha us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai jis ne use paida kiya; yeh currents par lagta hai (khula loop band farz karein). Andar dhakela magnet coil ke qareebi rukh ko N banata hai (magnet ki taraf se anticlockwise current); bahar khinchne par rukh S.

Energy: sarakti rod mein induced current v ke ulat force F_m = ILB deta hai; bahar ki force ko kaam karna parta hai jo electrical energy banta hai; clockwise current baghair source ke energy banata, is liye mumkin nahi. Examples: 3.13 × 10⁻² V; 0.48 V.
